island: 36 islands/islets, north → south. Islet list assembled from Wikipedia atoll pages; official '36 islands' lists differ slightly between sources (sand cays; Parali I eroded in 2017) – verify with the UT Administration.
Coordinates approximate (islet centroid; some islet positions estimated from atoll maps). Population ≈ Census 2011 – verify.
Multipliers scale the reference-island resource (wind/solar: Kadmat; SST: Kavaratti; wave: Agatti). Lagoon area is per atoll, shared by its islets.
Uninhabited islets: peak demand 0 except resort islands (Bangaram, Thinnakara). The challenge's 1 MW target can still be sized for any island.
Land area matters: islets < 0.05 km² cannot host utility wind turbines or a shore OTEC plant – floating PV / wave / offshore options only.
Kavaratti 3.8 km = length of NIOT's HDPE cold-water pipeline for the OTEC-desalination pilot (used as proxy). Orange = dummy placeholder.
